questions.text: A citizen is best defined as a person who
options: lives in a country for six months
owes allegiance to a state and enjoys its full rights
questions.explanation: Citizenship carries both rights, such as voting, and duties, such as obeying the law and paying tax.

questions.text: Which of the following is a duty rather than a right of a citizen?
questions.explanation: Rights are entitlements; duties such as tax payment and obedience to the law are obligations.

questions.text: Integrity in public life is best demonstrated by
options: refusing bribes and keeping to the truth
protecting one's ethnic group in appointments
questions.explanation: Integrity means consistent honesty and adherence to principle, especially when it is costly.

questions.text: The main purpose of the National Youth Service Corps scheme is to
questions.explanation: Graduates serve outside their states of origin so as to build understanding across ethnic lines.

questions.text: A key feature of a democratic government is
options: appointment of judges by the military
questions.explanation: Regular competitive elections make leaders accountable to the electorate.

questions.text: The rule of law implies that
options: the president is above the law
laws apply only to the poor
questions.explanation: Equality before the law is one of the central pillars of the doctrine.

questions.text: The agency responsible for controlling drug abuse and trafficking in Nigeria is
questions.explanation: The NDLEA enforces drug laws, while NAFDAC regulates food and drug standards.

questions.text: The body responsible for road safety on Nigerian highways is the
questions.explanation: The FRSC regulates traffic, licenses drivers and responds to road traffic crashes.

questions.text: The agency established to combat human trafficking in Nigeria is
questions.explanation: NAPTIP prosecutes traffickers and rehabilitates rescued victims.

questions.text: Public officers who fail in their duty can best be held accountable through
options: oversight by the legislature and the courts
questions.explanation: Legislative oversight, judicial review and an active civil society are the standard accountability mechanisms.

questions.text: An example of a civil society organisation is
questions.explanation: Civil society organisations are voluntary, non-governmental bodies that advance public interests.

questions.text: The most effective way for a student to avoid cultism is to
options: join a rival group for protection
keep good company and report threats to school authorities
pay the cult group for safety
questions.explanation: Positive peer groups and prompt reporting remove both the pressure and the perceived need for protection.

questions.text: A person who acquires citizenship because their parents are citizens has acquired it by
questions.explanation: Citizenship by descent follows the nationality of the parents regardless of place of birth.

questions.text: Fundamental human rights in Nigeria are guaranteed by
questions.explanation: Chapter IV enumerates the rights to life, dignity, personal liberty, fair hearing and others.

questions.text: Which of the following is a negative value that undermines national development?
questions.explanation: Corruption diverts public resources and weakens institutions and public trust.

questions.text: The commission established mainly to fight economic and financial crimes in Nigeria is the
questions.explanation: The EFCC investigates and prosecutes advance fee fraud, money laundering and related offences.

questions.text: Youth empowerment programmes are designed mainly to
options: equip young people with skills for self-reliance
questions.explanation: Vocational skills and access to credit enable young people to earn a living independently.

questions.text: The process by which the legislature removes a president for gross misconduct is
questions.explanation: Impeachment follows a constitutionally prescribed procedure involving investigation and a two-thirds majority.

questions.text: The procedure by which constituents remove an elected legislator before the end of their term is
questions.explanation: A recall is initiated by a petition signed by more than half of the registered voters in the constituency.

questions.text: The agency that manages disasters and emergencies in Nigeria is
questions.explanation: NEMA coordinates relief and response to floods, fires and other emergencies.

questions.text: Peaceful coexistence among ethnic groups is best promoted by
options: mutual respect, dialogue and inter-group cooperation
separate schools for each ethnic group
questions.explanation: Dialogue and shared institutions build the trust on which peaceful coexistence rests.

questions.text: Electoral malpractice includes all of the following except
questions.explanation: Accreditation is a lawful part of the process; the others are offences under the Electoral Act.

questions.text: A responsible parent is one who
options: provides for the education, health and moral upbringing of the child
leaves the child's training entirely to the school
questions.explanation: Parental responsibility covers material provision as well as moral guidance and supervision.

questions.text: The most direct way for a citizen to participate in governance is by
questions.explanation: Voting is the primary act of participation through which citizens choose and change their leaders.
